data.one_liner: Plugin to determine device capacities, low-end status, battery eco mode, and connectivity.
data.what_it_does: Evaluates hardware information, battery state, thermal state, and network connectivity to help implement custom eco-friendly power-saving modes in mobile apps.
use_when: You want to detect low-end devices or battery eco modes to reduce app resource consumption
You need detailed platform hardware, storage, memory, and connectivity info on Android and iOS
avoid_when: You only need standard device information handled better by alternative packages like device_info_plus
You require support for desktop or web platforms
strengths: Provides aggregated device range and battery eco-mode streams out of the box
Typed custom exceptions replace generic platform exceptions
Supports both Android and iOS platforms
weaknesses: Limited platform support (Android and iOS only)
Some network connectivity checks may require optional native runtime permissions on Android
data.setup_notes: Cellular network type detection on Android may require appropriate permissions.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard device and OS metadata without the eco-mode scoring wrapper.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only require standard network connectivity monitoring across multiple platforms.
